name: Lido EarnUSD
oneLiner: earnUSD is Lido's Mellow-curated vault share for dollar-denominated strategies; returns compound into NAV and USDC withdrawals use a request-and-claim queue.
collateral: Lido/Mellow earnUSD MetaVault allocates across earnUSDc (conservative) and earnUSDe (experimental) underlying vaults. The exact issuer API and deployment registry list USDC, USDT and USDe deposit assets; permitted deposits and USDC withdrawal denomination do not establish current allocation weights, holdings or encumbrances.
pegMechanism: Returns compound into vault shares using privileged oracle reports. Deposits and request-and-claim withdrawals are processed by queues; the documented USDC withdrawal wait is typically about three days, not a guaranteed maximum.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum 0x4ce1ac8f43e0e5bd7a346a98af777bf8fbea1981 is the deployed BurnableTokenizedShareManager proxy for vault 0x014e6da8f283c4af65b2aa0f201438680a004452. It records 50902385.14796045 transferable shares at block 26107703; vault.subvaults() returned 2. Lido documents compounded protocol-strategy returns and queued USDC exits; asset() and totalAssets() revert on this share token, so it is not an ordinary ERC-4626 reserve receipt. The protocol-position override records this exact operational claim rather than inheriting USDC's fiat-cash model. No legal segregation, current allocation or independent reconciliation is inferred.
